using JSON3
function sh(cmd)
    try
        strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $cmd`); stderr = devnull), String))
    catch e
        "ERR " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
    end
end
function bench()
    s = 0.0
    for i in 1:200_000_000
        s += sin(i * 1e-9)
    end
    s
end
t0 = time(); bench(); t1 = time() - t0
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["julia"] = string(VERSION)
res["host"] = sh("hostname")
res["nproc"] = sh("nproc")
res["nproc_all"] = sh("nproc --all")
res["cpus_on_node_env"] = get(ENV, "SLURM_CPUS_ON_NODE", "")
res["cpus_per_task_env"] = get(ENV, "SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "")
res["job_cpus_per_node"] = get(ENV, "SLURM_JOB_CPUS_PER_NODE", "")
res["lscpu"] = sh("lscpu | grep -E 'Model name|^CPU\\(s\\)|Thread|Core|Socket|MHz' | head -8")
res["mem"] = sh("free -g | head -2")
res["sinfo_gpu"] = sh("sinfo -p gpu -N -o '%N %c %m %t %G' 2>&1 | head -6")
res["sinfo_all"] = sh("sinfo -o '%P %a %l %D %c %m' 2>&1 | head -12")
res["scontrol_job"] = sh("scontrol show job \$SLURM_JOB_ID 2>&1 | grep -E 'TimeLimit|NumCPUs|Partition|MinCPUsNode|TRES' | head -5")
res["time_limit_assoc"] = sh("sacctmgr -n show assoc user=\$USER format=account,partition,maxjobs,maxsubmit,maxtres,grptres 2>&1 | head -5")
res["squeue_me"] = sh("squeue -u \$USER -h 2>&1 | wc -l")
res["work"] = sh("echo \$WORK; df -h \$WORK 2>&1 | tail -1")
res["github_https"] = sh("curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://github.com 2>&1")
res["pypi_https"] = sh("curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://pypi.org 2>&1")
res["julia_pkg_server"] = sh("curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://pkg.julialang.org 2>&1")
res["single_core_bench_s"] = t1
# scaling: run k copies of the same CPU loop as separate processes
code = "t0=time(); s=0.0; for i in 1:200_000_000; s += sin(i*1e-9); end; println(time()-t0)"
jl = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, "julia")
scal = Dict{String,Any}()
np = something(tryparse(Int, res["nproc"]), 1)
for k in unique(filter(x -> x <= max(np, 1), [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32]))
    t0 = time()
    procs = [open(pipeline(`$jl --startup-file=no -e $code`; stderr = devnull)) for _ in 1:k]
    ts = [parse(Float64, strip(read(p, String))) for p in procs]
    scal[string(k)] = Dict("wall" => time() - t0, "max_child" => maximum(ts), "min_child" => minimum(ts))
end
res["scaling"] = scal
println(JSON3.write(res))
